incidents.name: MCC reflection deliver() + pair skim
incidents.notes: MCC used the same RFI reflection accounting as HODL: deliver() burned the caller's reflected balance and inflated every other holder's tokenFromReflection(), and the attacker skimmed the inflated MCC out of the MCC/WETH pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: MCC 0x1a7981D87E3b6a95c1516EB820E223fE979896b3 created 2021-11-19T16:23:07Z by 0xfa21382cdf68cca1b3a7107a8cc80688eefbeebc (the fee-excluded address), unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (535.6 days). ~10 ETH x $1,842.04 at incidentTimestamp 1683617735 (DefiLlama) = $18,420.
